pictures.scene: El Greco, The Pentecost — a white dove blazing at the top of a dark vault with a tongue of flame standing over every head, the Virgin at the centre in blue and red with her hands joined, and the apostles pressed close about her in red, green and gold with their faces lifted into the light, when the day of pentecost came, they were all together in one place, suddenly a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting, and they saw tongues like flames of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_the_pentecost

pictures.scene: Bauernfeind, A Gate in Jerusalem — a huge pointed stone archway thrown right across the picture, the honey-coloured limestone blazing in the sun above and the vault cool with shadow beneath, a lamp hanging on a long chain, latticed windows in the overhanging houses, and the lane running away pale between them, and they were all filled with the holy spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the spirit enabled them, now there were dwelling in jerusalem god-fearing jews from every nation under heaven
pictures.name: pd_bauernfeind_jerusalem_gate

pictures.scene: Gentile Bellini, Procession in the Piazza San Marco — the great square laid out before the golden domes of the basilica with the four bronze horses above its door, a long procession of men in grey and white gowns carrying a gilt reliquary under a red canopy, and scores of onlookers in red and black standing along the whole breadth of the square, and when this sound rang out, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard them speaking his own language, astounded and amazed, they asked, are not all these men who are speaking galileans
pictures.name: pd_bellini_procession_piazza_san_marco

pictures.scene: Pasini, Caravan in the Desert — a line of camels strung out across burnt and empty country under a bleached sky, their drivers walking beside them with nothing in sight ahead, how is it then that each of us hears them in his own native language, parthians, medes, and elamites, residents of mesopotamia, judea and cappadocia, pontus and asia
pictures.name: pd_pasini_karavaan_in_de_woestijn

pictures.scene: Frere, The Caravan — the camel train coming out of the east across the open desert, the loaded beasts and their drivers small against a long low horizon, phrygia and pamphylia, egypt and the parts of libya near cyrene, visitors from rome, both jews and converts to judaism, cretans and arabs, we hear them declaring the wonders of god in our own tongues
pictures.name: pd_frere_caravane

pictures.scene: Brouwer, Peasants Drinking in the Tavern — four men crowded round a scarred table in a low brown room, one bawling with his head thrown back and a pipe held in his fist, another tipping a brown jug to his mouth, a third holding his glass up in the air and a fourth shouting over the noise with his hand raised, astounded and perplexed, they asked one another, what does this mean, but others mocked them and said, they are drunk on new wine
pictures.name: pd_brouwer_drinkende_boeren_in_de_herberg

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, St Peter Preaching in the Presence of St Mark — the apostle standing up above the listening crowd with his hand raised in speech and every face turned toward him, then peter stood up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and addressed the crowd, men of judea and all who dwell in jerusalem, let this be known to you, these men are not drunk, as you suppose, it is only the third hour of the day
pictures.name: pd_angelico_naam

pictures.scene: De Gelder, Jacob's Dream — a man asleep on the bare ground at the foot of a dark hillside, a white-robed angel with wide open wings coming down out of a break of golden light above him and a second brighter figure higher up in the glow, no, this is what was spoken by the prophet joel, in the last days, god says, i will pour out my spirit on all people, your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams
pictures.name: pd_de_gelder_jacobs_dream

pictures.scene: Dahl, Eruption of Vesuvius — the crater rim ablaze with a long band of white-hot lava under enormous billowing clouds of smoke shot through with sparks, and one tiny watching man standing out on the broken rock at the right, even on my menservants and maidservants i will pour out my spirit in those days, and they will prophesy, i will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke
pictures.name: pd_dahl_eruption_of_vesuvius

pictures.scene: Aert van der Neer, River View by Moonlight — a broad still river at night under worked grey cloud where the moon breaks through and lays a long pale track across the water, a windmill and a church tower and moored sailing barges along the far bank, a boatman loading a skiff among the reeds and a carter with his horses and his dog on the near shore, the sun will be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood, before the coming of the great and glorious day of the lord, and everyone who calls on the name of the lord will be saved
pictures.name: pd_van_der_neer_river_view_by_moonlight

pictures.scene: Zurbaran, The Crucifixion — Christ alone on the cross against a ground of near-black, the white loincloth standing out bright in the darkness, His head bowed on His shoulder, the titulus nailed above Him and His feet resting on a wooden block, men of israel, listen to this message, jesus of nazareth was a man certified by god to you by miracles, wonders, and signs, he was delivered up by god's set plan and foreknowledge, and you, by the hands of the lawless, put him to death by nailing him to the cross
pictures.name: pd_zurbaran_crucifixion

pictures.scene: Tintoretto, The Resurrection — the risen Christ rising out of the dark with a banner in His hand and drapery across His hips, and a press of angels below Him in the shadow, but god raised him from the dead, releasing him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for him to be held in its clutches, david says about him, i saw the lord always before me, because he is at my right hand, i will not be shaken
pictures.name: pd_tintoretto_overwinning

pictures.scene: Bertin, Landscape, Morning — great trees spreading over two small figures on a path, a flock of sheep grazing down by a river, blue hills beyond and the whole country washed in early light, therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices, my body also will dwell in hope, because you will not abandon my soul to hades, nor will you let your holy one see decay
pictures.name: pd_bertin_paysage_le_matin

pictures.scene: Ruisdael, The Jewish Cemetery — stone tombs standing in the long grass under a great dark oak and a half-dead white birch, a ruined church on the hill behind and a storm sky breaking over it, and not one living figure anywhere in the picture, you have made known to me the paths of life, you will fill me with joy in your presence, brothers, i can tell you with confidence that the patriarch david died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_jewish_cemetery

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, God the Father — one enthroned figure facing us in a jewelled triple tiara and a crimson robe with a great jewelled clasp, a dark beard, gold rays about his head and a gold inscription arching behind him, but he was a prophet and knew that god had promised him on oath that he would place one of his descendants on his throne, foreseeing this, david spoke about the resurrection of the christ, that he was not abandoned to hades, nor did his body see decay
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_god_the_father

pictures.scene: Copley, The Ascension — Christ rising in white with both arms spread wide out of a gold-lit cloud, the apostles below Him on the rock with their hands raised and their faces turned up, and an angel in white standing at the right, god has raised this jesus to life, to which we are all witnesses, exalted, then, to the right hand of god, he has received from the father the promised holy spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear
pictures.name: pd_copley_ascension

pictures.scene: Master of Cefalu, Christ Pantocrator — the apse half-dome filled with Christ in a blue mantle, His right hand raised in blessing and an open book held against Him with Greek and Latin written across the pages, and below Him Mary with her hands raised between two archangels, for david did not ascend into heaven, but he himself says, the lord said to my lord, sit at my right hand until i make your enemies a footstool for your feet
pictures.name: pd_master_of_cefalu_christ_pantocrator

pictures.scene: Bendemann, The Jews Mourning in Exile — an old white-bearded man in red sitting with a chain on his wrist and a harp across his lap, his hand still resting on the strings, and a young woman with braided golden hair weeping against his shoulder with her face hidden, therefore let all israel know with certainty that god has made this jesus, whom you crucified, both lord and christ, when the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and asked peter and the other apostles, brothers, what shall we do
pictures.name: pd_bendemann_jews_mourning_in_exile

pictures.scene: Patinir, The Baptism of Christ — John in camel hair and a brown mantle holding his hand over the head of Christ, who stands in the river with His hands joined and a white cloth about Him, the dove descending and the Father in the clouds above, and a wide blue landscape opening away behind them, peter replied, repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of jesus christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the holy spirit, this promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off
pictures.name: pd_patinir_baptism

pictures.scene: Emanuel de Witte, Interior of the Oude Kerk in Amsterdam during a Sermon — a preacher in black leaning out from a high pulpit against a whitewashed pillar, rows of hats behind the panelled screen, families with their children and a spaniel sitting in the sunlight on the stone floor, and tall gothic windows above, with many other words he testified, and he urged them, be saved from this corrupt generation, those who embraced his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to the believers that day
pictures.name: pd_de_witte_interior_of_the_oude_kerk_amsterdam_during_a_sermon

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Supper at Emmaus — Christ at a small round table under a great dark arch with a faint ring of light about His head, breaking a loaf in both hands, one disciple with his hand at his mouth and one pushed back in his chair, and a serving boy bending in with a dish, they devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer, a sense of awe came over everyone, and the apostles performed many wonders and signs
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_supper_at_emmaus

pictures.scene: Master of Alkmaar, The Works of Mercy, Feeding the Hungry — a woman in a white cap and apron standing at her door with a basket of round loaves, a young man in a blue gown handing the bread out, and a poor crowd pressing in for it, a baby on a shoulder, a child reaching up, a crippled man on the ground with wooden hand-crutches, a brown dog on the cobbles, and Christ standing quietly among the poor, all the believers were together and had everything in common, selling their possessions and goods, they shared with anyone who was in need
pictures.name: pd_alkmaar_barmhartigheid

pictures.scene: Jan Steen, Prayer before the Meal — a mother in a white cap sitting by an open window with her baby on her lap, a loaf and a cheese on the white cloth before her, the father opposite with his hat pressed to his chest and his head bowed, a plate of meat on an upturned barrel and a written text pinned to the wall behind them, with one accord they continued to meet daily in the temple courts and to break bread from house to house, sharing their meals with gladness and sincerity of heart, praising god and enjoying the favor of all the people
pictures.name: pd_steen_prayer_before_the_meal

lines.text: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place. Suddenly a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.
They saw tongues like flames of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.
And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.
Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.
And when this sound rang out, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard them speaking his own language.
Astounded and amazed, they asked, Are not all these men who are speaking Galileans?
How is it then that each of us hears them in his own native language?
Parthians, Medes, and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome,
both Jews and converts to Judaism; Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!
Astounded and perplexed, they asked one another, What does this mean?
But others mocked them and said, They are drunk on new wine!
Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, lifted up his voice, and addressed the crowd: Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen carefully to my words.
These men are not drunk, as you suppose. It is only the third hour of the day!
No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
In the last days, God says, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.
Even on My menservants and maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.
I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.
The sun will be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood, before the coming of the great and glorious Day of the Lord.
And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.
Men of Israel, listen to this message: Jesus of Nazareth was a man certified by God to you by miracles, wonders, and signs, which God did among you through Him, as you yourselves know.
He was delivered up by God's set plan and foreknowledge, and you, by the hands of the lawless, put Him to death by nailing Him to the cross.
But God raised Him from the dead, releasing Him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for Him to be held in its clutches.
David says about Him: I saw the Lord always before me; because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell in hope,
because You will not abandon my soul to Hades, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.
Brothers, I can tell you with confidence that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that He would place one of his descendants on his throne.
Foreseeing this, David spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that He was not abandoned to Hades, nor did His body see decay.
God has raised this Jesus to life, to which we are all witnesses.
Exalted, then, to the right hand of God, He has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.
For David did not ascend into heaven, but he himself says: The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at My right hand
until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.
Therefore let all Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ!
When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and asked Peter and the other apostles, Brothers, what shall we do?
Peter replied, Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off—to all whom the Lord our God will call to Himself.
With many other words he testified, and he urged them, Be saved from this corrupt generation.
Those who embraced his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to the believers that day.
They devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
A sense of awe came over everyone, and the apostles performed many wonders and signs.
All the believers were together and had everything in common.
Selling their possessions and goods, they shared with anyone who was in need.
With one accord they continued to meet daily in the temple courts and to break bread from house to house, sharing their meals with gladness and sincerity of heart,
praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.
